en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It is narrated that Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) said, “

If three days  of  a  person’s  life  pass  by  without  reciting  Surah Tauheed,  he  is  without  a  companion.  Faith  will  be  taken away from him and if that person dies after these three days, he will die as a disbeliever of Allah, the Greatest.”
